replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially during exams or when faced with difficult proofs. The pressure to perform can trigger anxiety, making it hard to focus and think clearly.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I've used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for solving equations and checking my work. It's been helpful for verifying solutions but doesn't replace critical thinking skills.
